{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# For each patient, take the mean of biomarker_final across all their rows
# This handles the case where a patient has multiple entries
patient_means = df.groupby('patient_id')['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Then compute the overall mean across all patients
mean_biomarker_final_by_patient = patient_means.mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_final_by_patient"}
